title: wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 ACK message processing heap-buffer-overflow
bug_class: DTLS 1.3 ACK record processing heap buffer overflow
notes: Selected from official wolfSSL 2026 vulnerability list. CVE-2026-5264 is a DTLS 1.3 ACK message processing heap-buffer-overflow. PR #10076 adds ACK record count bounds, seenRecordsCount tracking, and DTLS 1.3 ACK overflow tests. Candidate should be reproduced through DTLS 1.3 ACK handling path, preferably using official PR test pattern. Vulnerable reproduction confirmed on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable: 4097 DTLS 1.3 ACK records trigger ASan out-of-bounds write in c64toa via Dtls13WriteAckMessage. Fixed/current validation pending. Fixed release verified on wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable: 4097 attempted ACK records are bounded to seenRecordsCount 128 and Dtls13WriteAckMessage completes without ASan crash. Version matrix complete: vulnerable v5.9.0-stable reproduces ASan out-of-bounds heap write in Dtls13WriteAckMessage; fixed v5.9.1-stable and current wolfSSL safely bound seenRecordsCount to 128 and complete without sanitizer evidence.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable triggers an ASan-visible out-of-bounds heap write when 4097 DTLS 1.3 ACK records are serialized through Dtls13WriteAckMessage. The crash stack includes c64toa and Dtls13WriteAckMessage, with WRITE of size 8 0 bytes after a heap allocation.
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable and current wolfSSL bound the DTLS 1.3 ACK record list to seenRecordsCount 128 under the reconstructed 4097-record ACK stress pattern. Dtls13WriteAckMessage returns 0, encoded ACK length is 2050, exit code is 0, and no ASan crash is observed.
